calls.prompt: Full-body orthographic front view of an arcane warden, a tall stern figure of the Roman era in a long plain grey wool robe that reaches the ankles, with a deep hood drawn up over the head, a stern gaunt bare face with a strong brow and a straight mouth visible under the hood, a plain collar band at the neck, wide open sleeves ending at the wrists, a narrow darker grey sash at the waist, and plain dark leather sandals. He stands in a neutral A-pose: arms straight, held out and angled about 35 degrees down away from the torso so the sleeves do not touch the robe, the left hand open with fingers together and the right hand a loosely curled empty fist, legs slightly apart under the robe, feet flat. No staff, no weapon, no fire, no effects. He faces the camera directly, symmetrical, the whole figure from head to sandals visible with empty margin around it, centred on a plain flat light grey background, no scenery, no ground, a single character. Game-ready 3D character model reference for a modeller: simple large readable shapes, chunky proportions, big hands, matte surfaces, one flat colour per material with no pattern and no texture detail. Palette blocks: robe, hood and sleeves mid slate grey, sash dark charcoal grey, collar band and hem trim muted bronze, sandals dark brown leather, skin pale warm tan, brows and any hair grey. Soft even studio light, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no grid, no watermark.
